name: SkynetZero v11 · epoch 120

selection.Reason: Promote only after complete color-swapped development pairs with guaranteed game score > 0.5 both overall and after deduplication, and an exact one-sided paired sign-test p <= 0.05. Caps receive zero credit. Repeated opening identities, supplied move prefixes, or identical paired trajectories count as one evidence group, using its worst pair score. Tied groups do not enter the sign test; at least five favorable non-tied groups are necessary. Repeated sequential challenges and related openings do not provide a global confidence or strength guarantee.

selectionNote: Last arena-promoted checkpoint from the latest training run. The run stopped at epoch 1079; no weight updates were retained after epoch 396. Promotion was against the initial v11 model; superiority over the previous website v10 model has not been established.

promotionEvidence.Reason: Guaranteed game score and paired sign-test thresholds passed.

browserDifferences: Single-thread, bounded browser search; strength levels set depth, nodes and time.
Managed C# compact MLP inference with original float32 weights and double accumulation for the linear skip, matching native FrozenCompactInference.
Supplied opening repertoire is retained; optional strategy/tactics ordering and learned opening discoveries are not bundled.
The checkpoint evaluation-table snapshot is used for play and review, with native root-travel scoping; online sacrifice-table learning is disabled.
